visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a view of a wooden counter set against a vibrant red-framed window looking out onto greenery. A vintage clock hangs on the cream-colored wall next to a blackboard with Chinese text. Lighting is bright and natural. (2) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a black t-shirt, enters through a glass door into the cafe. The indoor lighting is soft and warm. (3) Close-up shot of a roasted duck leg sitting on a bed of bright yellow pumpkin risotto. A fork pulls the succulent pink meat from the bone. (4) Transition to a close-up of seafood pasta featuring numerous open clams and large scallops topped with salmon roe and seaweed. A fork lifts a bundle of thin noodles coated in a thick, pink mentaiko sauce. (5) A wooden tray holding a fried seafood platter is placed on the table, containing golden-brown fried prawns, fish, and squid rings. A small dish of tartar sauce sits beside them. (6) Close-up of a glass of dark iced coffee with a lemon slice being stirred with a metal spoon. This is followed by a shot of a pink berry smoothie topped with edible yellow and white flowers. (7) Interior shot of the dining room showing empty black chairs and white tables under warm pendant lights. (8) Exterior shot of the cafe titled 'Hun Man Kitchen' featuring a white building with red window frames and a scooter parked outside.
